title: NiCat07's TARDIS Desktops
description: A small datapack containing custom desktops for the TARDIS: Refined mod
body:
This is a small datapack generated by [TARDIS: Refined](https://modrinth.com/mod/tardis-refined)'s built-in datapack creator.

Current desktop count: 2

**Assimilated:** a sculk-and-amethyst desktop featuring large amethyst spikes, a few bones, and way too much sculk. If the sculk sensors become annoying, feel free to remove them.

**End Island:** an End-themed desktop that flaunts the non-euclidean nature of the TARDIS. It features a miniature end stone island with the door on an obsidian platform, the airlock inside the island, and five obsidian pillars topped with end crystals.
